findings.desc: run-injection-arms.mjs:147 selfTest() called without await — if selfTest() throws unexpectedly (distinct from its own process.exit(1) failure path), the rejection is unhandled and produces a cryptic UnhandledPromiseRejection trace rather than selfTest()'s clear FAIL summary. Fix: await selfTest() (top-level await is valid in .mjs) or selfTest().catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); }).
